description_en: Queries the dashboard metrics for a specified instance
description_zh: 查询指定实例的整理仪表盘数据
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-dashboard-metrics --instance-id airec-cn-o400whm78004 --start-time 1586673466 --end-time 1586673466 --metric-type '指标类型_USERACTIONPV_COUNT' --metric-view ITEM --metric-query dimension:ITEM_TYPE_behaviorType:expose --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDashboardMetrics

parameters.help_en: The start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The metric type. Valid values:

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: Total page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: Total unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: Traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: Per capita traffic
parameters.help_zh:
指标类型

USER_ACTION_PV_COUNT 整体流量规模PV

USER_ACTION_UV_COUNT 整体流量规模UV

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO 流量转化率

USER_ACTION_UV_RATIO 人均流量
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The dimension of the query. This parameter is used with \`metricQuery\`. The default value is \`USER\`. Valid values are \`USER\` (the user dimension) and \`ITEM\` (the item dimension)
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度，配合metricQuery使用，默认值为USER, 枚举值如下；
 USER 用户维度,
 ITEM  物品维度
parameters.name: metric_view

parameters.help_en: The query condition. The format is k1:v1;k2:v2
parameters.name: metric_query
